title: Read mesh/case
interactive: /file/read-case → case file name [".cas.h5"] → file name (accepts .msh too)
notes: Line from the user's working journal (it uses the space form `/file read-case`; the slash form is equivalent, 19_SCHEME_JOURNAL/journal_syntax.md §2.1).
